purpose: Invented FMM field/extraction fixtures only; no real data, ray bending, or inversion.
limitations: These component tests do not establish first-arrival branch completeness or final bent-ray accuracy.
The 1e-12 second homogeneous action allowance covers floating-point roundoff and is not a ray-convergence tolerance.

Default half-open source-seed reflection failures are retained as a comparison; pass status applies to closed-cell-union symmetry, exact endpoints, monotone extraction, physical action bounds, and bitwise unchanged off-grid fields/paths.
